sonnet.problem: The fill-in-the-blank asks the baker to supply the missing word of the master's line, "faithful in a very ___ matter." The previous story card (the first servant's report) gives nothing to reason from. The answer has to be guessed from wording the baker hasn't seen, and the wrong answers ("great", "hard") are just other guesses at the word.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
